cohort: Very-low-birth-weight infants (VLBWIs) born between January 2013 and December 2020, registered in the Korean Neonatal Network, excluding those who died within 5 postnatal days or did not receive surfactant.
finding: Low gestational age, male sex, cesarean section, maternal hypertensive disorder, and low 5-minute Apgar scores were significantly associated with an increased risk of refractory RDS, while antenatal corticosteroid use and maternal chorioamnionitis were inversely associated.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of refractory RDS (aOR = 1.59, 95% CI [1.38, 1.80]).
